text: Appointments to the Applegrove Community Complex Board of Management are a matter for which the Community Council has been delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision, provided that the recommendations do not vary from the City of Toronto's Public Appointments Policy. At its meeting on October 23, 2017, the Board of Management for Applegrove Community Complex accepted the resignation of Mercedes Lee who had been appointed for a term ending on March 31, 2018. At its meeting November 20, 2017, and in accordance with Applegrove’s Constitution, the Board of Management selected a qualified individual, Stacey Young, to serve the remainder of the term expiring March 31, 2018. The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Appointed, at pleasure of Council, the following public member to the Applegrove Community Complex Board of Management for a term of office ending on March 31, 2018: - Stacey Young
